module Definitions
  BUILTINS = %w[__LINE__ __FILE__ __COUNTER__].freeze
  VARIADIC = '__VA_ARGS__'
  VARIADIC_ERROR = '"__VA_ARGS__" can only appear in the expansion of a variadic macro'
  class Error < StandardError; end

  class Macro
    attr_reader :name, :parameters, :variadic, :replacement, :position, :main_file
    attr_accessor :expanded, :tested

    def initialize(name, parameters, variadic, replacement, position, main_file)
      @name, @parameters, @variadic = name, parameters, variadic
      @replacement, @position, @main_file = replacement, position, main_file
      @expanded = @tested = 0
    end

    def signature
      return name unless parameters
      names = parameters.dup
      names[-1] = '...' if variadic
      "#{name}(#{names.join(', ')})"
    end

    def identical?(other)
      parameters == other.parameters && variadic == other.variadic &&
        replacement.map { |t| [t.spelling, t.space] } == other.replacement.map { |t| [t.spelling, t.space] }
    end
  end

  module_function

  def check_name(tokens, directive)
    return "no macro name given in ##{directive} directive" if tokens.empty?
    return 'macro names must be identifiers' unless tokens[0].kind == :identifier
    name = tokens[0].spelling
    return '"defined" cannot be used as a macro name' if name == 'defined'
    if BUILTINS.include?(name)
      operation = directive == 'define' ? 'redefine' : 'undefine'
      return "cannot #{operation} builtin macro \"#{name}\""
    end
    nil
  end

  def parse(tokens, position, main_file)
    error = check_name(tokens, 'define')
    raise Error, error if error
    name = tokens[0].spelling
    raise Error, VARIADIC_ERROR if name == VARIADIC
    parameters, variadic, index = nil, false, 1
    if tokens[1]&.spelling == '(' && !tokens[1].space
      parameters, index = [], 2
      raise Error, "missing ')' in macro parameter list" unless tokens[index]
      if tokens[index].spelling == ')'
        index += 1
      else
        loop do
          token = tokens[index]
          raise Error, "missing ')' in macro parameter list" unless token
          if token.spelling == '...'
            parameters << VARIADIC
            variadic = true
          elsif token.kind == :identifier
            raise Error, VARIADIC_ERROR if token.spelling == VARIADIC
            raise Error, "duplicate macro parameter \"#{token.spelling}\"" if parameters.include?(token.spelling)
            parameters << token.spelling
          else
            raise Error, "expected parameter name, found \"#{token.spelling}\""
          end
          index += 1
          raise Error, "missing ')' in macro parameter list" unless tokens[index]
          following = tokens[index].spelling
          index += 1
          break if following == ')'
          raise Error, "expected ')' after \"...\", found \"#{following}\"" if variadic
          raise Error, "expected ',' or ')', found \"#{following}\"" unless following == ','
        end
      end
    end
    replacement = tokens[index..].dup
    unless replacement.empty?
      replacement[0] = replacement[0].with(space: false)
      if [replacement.first.spelling, replacement.last.spelling].include?('##')
        raise Error, "'##' cannot appear at either end of a macro expansion"
      end
    end
    replacement.each_with_index do |token, i|
      raise Error, VARIADIC_ERROR if token.kind == :identifier && token.spelling == VARIADIC && !variadic
      if token.spelling == '#' && parameters
        following = replacement[i + 1]
        unless following&.kind == :identifier && parameters.include?(following.spelling)
          raise Error, "'#' is not followed by a macro parameter"
        end
      end
    end
    Macro.new(name, parameters, variadic, replacement, position, main_file)
  end
end

require_relative 'lexer'
require_relative 'definitions'

class Expander
  attr_reader :builtin_counts

  def initialize(macros, diagnostic)
    @macros, @diagnostic = macros, diagnostic
    @counter = 0
    @builtin_counts = Hash.new(0)
  end

  def error(context, token, message)
    @diagnostic.call(context.position(token.line), 'error', message)
  end

  def builtin(token, context)
    builtin_counts[token.spelling] += 1
    case token.spelling
    when '__FILE__'
      Token.make(:string, '"' + context.display_file + '"', token.line, token.space)
    when '__LINE__'
      Token.make(:number, context.position(token.line)[1].to_s, token.line, token.space)
    else
      result = Token.make(:number, @counter.to_s, token.line, token.space)
      @counter += 1
      result
    end
  end

  def collect(pending, macro, token, context)
    arguments, separators, nesting = [[]], [], 0
    closing, consumed = nil, nil
    pending.reverse_each.with_index do |current, index|
      next if index.zero?
      if current.spelling == ')' && nesting.zero?
        closing, consumed = current, index + 1
        break
      elsif current.spelling == ',' && nesting.zero?
        separators << current
        arguments << []
      else
        nesting += 1 if current.spelling == '('
        nesting -= 1 if current.spelling == ')'
        arguments[-1] << current
      end
    end
    unless closing
      error(context, token, "unterminated argument list invoking macro \"#{macro.name}\"")
      return nil
    end
    count = arguments.length
    fixed = macro.parameters.length - (macro.variadic ? 1 : 0)
    message = if !macro.variadic && fixed.zero? && !(count == 1 && arguments[0].empty?)
                "macro \"#{macro.name}\" passed #{count} arguments, but takes just 0"
              elsif count < fixed
                "macro \"#{macro.name}\" requires #{fixed} arguments, but only #{count} given"
              elsif count > fixed && !macro.variadic
                "macro \"#{macro.name}\" passed #{count} arguments, but takes just #{fixed}"
              end
    if message
      error(context, token, message)
      return nil
    end
    raw = macro.parameters.take(fixed).zip(arguments.take(fixed)).to_h
    if macro.variadic
      variable = []
      (fixed...count).each do |index|
        variable << separators[index - 1] if index > fixed
        variable.concat(arguments[index])
      end
      raw[Definitions::VARIADIC] = variable
    end
    [raw, consumed, closing]
  end

  def stringize(tokens, sharp)
    spelling = tokens.each_with_index.map do |token, index|
      text = token.spelling
      text = text.gsub(/[\\"]/) { |character| '\\' + character } if [:string, :character].include?(token.kind)
      (index.positive? && token.space ? ' ' : '') + text
    end.join
    Token.make(:string, '"' + spelling + '"', sharp.line, sharp.space)
  end

  def paste(left, right, token, context)
    return [right.with(space: left.space)] if left.kind == :placemarker
    return [left] if right.kind == :placemarker
    spelling = left.spelling + right.spelling
    kind = Lexer.single_token(spelling)
    return [Token.make(kind, spelling, left.line, left.space, left.hide & right.hide)] if kind
    error(context, token, "pasting \"#{left.spelling}\" and \"#{right.spelling}\" does not give a valid preprocessing token")
    [left, right.with(space: false)]
  end

  def build_items(state)
    macro, raw, items = state.values_at(:macro, :raw, :items)
    replacement = macro.replacement
    while state[:index] < replacement.length
      index = state[:index]
      current = replacement[index]
      if current.spelling == '#' && macro.parameters
        items << [stringize(raw[replacement[index + 1].spelling], current)]
        state[:index] += 2
        next
      elsif current.spelling == '##'
        items << current
      elsif current.kind == :identifier && raw.key?(current.spelling)
        adjacent = replacement[index - 1]&.spelling == '##' && index.positive? || replacement[index + 1]&.spelling == '##'
        unless adjacent || state[:expanded].key?(current.spelling)
          return [current.spelling, raw[current.spelling]]
        end
        sequence = adjacent ? raw[current.spelling] : state[:expanded][current.spelling]
        items << if sequence.empty?
                   [Token.make(:placemarker, '', current.line, current.space)]
                 else
                   [sequence[0].with(space: current.space), *sequence.drop(1)]
                 end
      else
        items << [current]
      end
      state[:index] += 1
    end
    nil
  end

  def finish_substitution(state, context)
    token, hide, items = state.values_at(:token, :hide, :items)
    pasted, index = [], 0
    while index < items.length
      item = items[index]
      if item.is_a?(Token)
        left = pasted.pop
        right = items[index + 1]
        right = [right] if right.is_a?(Token)
        pasted.concat(paste(left, right[0], token, context))
        pasted.concat(right.drop(1))
        index += 2
      else
        pasted.concat(item)
        index += 1
      end
    end
    result, carry = [], false
    pasted.each do |current|
      if current.kind == :placemarker
        carry ||= current.space
      else
        result << current.with(line: token.line, space: current.space || carry, hide: (current.hide | hide).freeze)
        carry = false
      end
    end
    result[0] = result[0].with(space: token.space) unless result.empty?
    result
  end

  def expansion_frame(sequence)
    {pending: sequence.reverse, result: [], substitution: nil, argument: nil}
  end

  def expand(sequence, context)
    frames = [expansion_frame(sequence)]
    until frames.empty?
      frame = frames[-1]
      pending, result, state = frame.values_at(:pending, :result, :substitution)
      if state
        job = build_items(state)
        if job
          frame[:argument] = job[0]
          frames << expansion_frame(job[1])
          next
        end
        replacement = finish_substitution(state, context)
        state[:macro].expanded += 1
        if replacement.empty? && state[:token].space && !pending.empty?
          pending[-1] = pending[-1].with(space: true)
        end
        pending.concat(replacement.reverse)
        frame[:substitution] = nil
        next
      end
      if pending.empty?
        frames.pop
        return result if frames.empty?
        parent = frames[-1]
        parent[:substitution][:expanded][parent[:argument]] = result
        next
      end
      token = pending.pop
      if token.kind != :identifier || token.hide.include?(token.spelling)
        result << token
      elsif Definitions::BUILTINS.include?(token.spelling)
        result << builtin(token, context)
      else
        macro = @macros[token.spelling]
        if !macro || (macro.parameters && pending[-1]&.spelling != '(')
          result << token
          next
        end
        raw, hide = {}, token.hide | Set[macro.name]
        if macro.parameters
          collected = collect(pending, macro, token, context)
          unless collected
            result << token
            next
          end
          raw, consumed, closing = collected
          consumed.times { pending.pop }
          hide = (token.hide & closing.hide) | Set[macro.name]
        end
        frame[:substitution] = {macro: macro, raw: raw, token: token, hide: hide,
                                index: 0, items: [], expanded: {}}
      end
    end
  end
end

module Expression
  LEVELS = [%w[||], %w[&&], %w[|], %w[^], %w[&], %w[== !=], %w[< > <= >=], %w[<< >>], %w[+ -], %w[* / %]].freeze
  class Error < StandardError; end
  module_function

  def integer(spelling)
    value = spelling.sub(/(?:ll|LL|l|L)\z/, '')
    return value.to_i(16) if value.match?(/\A0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+\z/)
    return value.to_i(8) if value.match?(/\A0[0-7]*\z/)
    return value.to_i if value.match?(/\A[1-9][0-9]*\z/)
    raise Error, "invalid integer constant \"#{spelling}\""
  end

  def character(spelling)
    value = spelling[1...-1]
    return value.ord if value.length == 1 && !["'", '\\'].include?(value)
    escapes = {'n' => 10, 't' => 9, '\\' => 92, "'" => 39, '"' => 34, '0' => 0}
    return escapes[value[1]] if value.length == 2 && value[0] == '\\' && escapes.key?(value[1])
    raise Error, "invalid character constant #{spelling}"
  end

  def parse(tokens, directive)
    raise Error, "##{directive} with no expression" if tokens.empty?
    tasks, values, position = [[:expression]], [], 0
    until tasks.empty?
      operation, *args = tasks.pop
      spelling = tokens[position]&.spelling
      case operation
      when :expression
        tasks.push([:conditional], [:binary, 0])
      when :conditional
        if spelling == '?'
          position += 1
          tasks.push([:middle, values.pop], [:expression])
        end
      when :middle
        raise Error, "'?' without following ':'" unless spelling == ':'
        position += 1
        tasks.push([:finish_conditional, args[0], values.pop], [:expression])
      when :finish_conditional
        values << [:conditional, args[0], args[1], values.pop]
      when :binary
        level = args[0]
        if level == LEVELS.length
          tasks << [:unary]
        else
          tasks.push([:binary_tail, level], [:binary, level + 1])
        end
      when :binary_tail
        level = args[0]
        if LEVELS[level].include?(spelling)
          position += 1
          tasks.push([:finish_binary, level, spelling, values.pop], [:binary, level + 1])
        end
      when :finish_binary
        level, operator, left = args
        values << [:binary, operator, left, values.pop]
        tasks << [:binary_tail, level]
      when :unary
        if %w[+ - ! ~].include?(spelling)
          position += 1
          tasks.push([:finish_unary, spelling], [:unary])
          next
        end
        token = tokens[position]
        raise Error, 'expected value at end of expression' unless token
        position += 1
        case token.kind
        when :number then values << [:constant, integer(token.spelling)]
        when :character then values << [:constant, character(token.spelling)]
        when :identifier then values << [:identifier, token.spelling]
        else
          raise Error, "expected value before \"#{token.spelling}\"" unless token.spelling == '('
          tasks.push([:closing], [:expression])
        end
      when :closing
        raise Error, "missing ')' in expression" unless spelling == ')'
        position += 1
      when :finish_unary
        values << [:unary, args[0], values.pop]
      end
    end
    raise Error, "missing binary operator before \"#{tokens[position].spelling}\"" if position < tokens.length
    values[0]
  end

  def binary(operator, left, right)
    case operator
    when '/', '%'
      raise Error, 'division by zero in #if' if right.zero?
      quotient = left.abs / right.abs
      quotient = -quotient if left.negative? != right.negative?
      operator == '/' ? quotient : left - right * quotient
    when '+' then left + right
    when '-' then left - right
    when '*' then left * right
    when '<<' then left << right
    when '>>' then left >> right
    when '&' then left & right
    when '|' then left | right
    when '^' then left ^ right
    else
      (left.public_send(operator, right)) ? 1 : 0
    end
  end

  def evaluate(tree, &warning)
    tasks, values = [[:evaluate, tree]], []
    until tasks.empty?
      operation, item = tasks.pop
      case operation
      when :evaluate
        case item[0]
        when :constant then values << item[1]
        when :identifier
          warning.call("identifier \"#{item[1]}\" evaluates to 0")
          values << 0
        when :unary then tasks.push([:unary, item[1]], [:evaluate, item[2]])
        when :conditional then tasks.push([:choose, [item[2], item[3]]], [:evaluate, item[1]])
        when :binary
          if %w[&& ||].include?(item[1])
            tasks.push([:logical, [item[1], item[3]]], [:evaluate, item[2]])
          else
            tasks.push([:binary, item[1]], [:evaluate, item[3]], [:evaluate, item[2]])
          end
        end
      when :choose then tasks << [:evaluate, values.pop.zero? ? item[1] : item[0]]
      when :logical
        left = values.pop
        if (item[0] == '&&' && left.zero?) || (item[0] == '||' && !left.zero?)
          values << (left.zero? ? 0 : 1)
        else
          tasks.push([:truth, nil], [:evaluate, item[1]])
        end
      when :truth then values << (values.pop.zero? ? 0 : 1)
      when :unary
        value = values.pop
        values << case item
                  when '+' then value
                  when '-' then -value
                  when '!' then value.zero? ? 1 : 0
                  when '~' then -value - 1
                  end
      when :binary
        right, left = values.pop, values.pop
        values << binary(item, left, right)
      end
    end
    values[0]
  end
end

require_relative 'lexer'

module IncludeSyntax
  STARTS = %w[if ifdef ifndef].freeze
  BRANCHES = %w[elif elifdef elifndef else].freeze
  module_function

  def directive_name(tokens)
    tokens[1].spelling if tokens[0]&.spelling == '#' && tokens[1]&.kind == :identifier
  end

  def guard(lines)
    nonempty = lines.map(&:tokens).reject(&:empty?)
    return nil if nonempty.empty?
    first, last = nonempty.first, nonempty.last
    return nil unless first.length == 3 && directive_name(first) == 'ifndef' && first[2].kind == :identifier
    return nil unless last.length == 2 && directive_name(last) == 'endif'
    depth = 0
    nonempty.each_with_index do |tokens, index|
      name = directive_name(tokens)
      return nil if BRANCHES.include?(name) && depth == 1
      depth += 1 if STARTS.include?(name)
      depth -= 1 if name == 'endif'
      return nil if depth == 0 && index != nonempty.length - 1
    end
    first[2].spelling if depth == 0
  end
end

class SourceFile
  attr_reader :path, :physical_lines, :lines, :guard
  attr_accessor :once, :entered, :skipped, :output_lines, :skipped_lines

  def initialize(path, contents)
    @path, @physical_lines = path, contents.count("\n")
    @lines = Lexer.source(contents)
    @guard = IncludeSyntax.guard(lines)
    @once = false
    @entered = @skipped = @output_lines = @skipped_lines = 0
  end
end

class IncludeManager
  attr_reader :files

  def initialize
    @files = {}
  end

  def search(name, quoted)
    paths = quoted ? [name, "include/#{name}"] : ["include/#{name}"]
    paths.find { |path| File.file?(File.join('input', path)) }
  end

  def load(path)
    files[path] ||= SourceFile.new(path, File.binread(File.join('input', path)))
  end
end

require 'set'

Token = Data.define(:kind, :spelling, :line, :space, :hide) do
  def self.make(kind, spelling, line, space, hide = Set.new)
    new(kind, spelling, line, space, hide.freeze)
  end
end
LogicalLine = Data.define(:tokens, :start, :finish)

module Lexer
  PUNCTUATORS = %w[... <<= >>= -> ++ -- << >> <= >= == != && || *= /= %= += -= &= ^= |= ## [ ] ( ) { } . & * + - ~ ! / % < > ^ | ? : ; = , #].freeze
  module_function

  def read_token(text, position = 0, header = false)
    character = text[position]
    if header && character == '<'
      closing = text.index('>', position + 1)
      newline = text.index("\n", position + 1)
      return [:header, text[position..closing], closing + 1] if closing && (!newline || closing < newline)
    end
    tail = text[position..]
    if (identifier = /\A[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*/.match(tail))
      spelling = identifier[0]
      return [:identifier, spelling, position + spelling.length]
    end
    if character&.match?(/[0-9]/) || (character == '.' && text[position + 1]&.match?(/[0-9]/))
      ending = position + 1
      while ending < text.length
        if text[ending].match?(/[eEpP]/) && text[ending + 1]&.match?(/[+-]/)
          ending += 2
        elsif text[ending].match?(/[A-Za-z_0-9.]/)
          ending += 1
        else
          break
        end
      end
      return [:number, text[position...ending], ending]
    end
    if ['"', "'"].include?(character)
      ending = position + 1
      while ending < text.length && text[ending] != "\n"
        if text[ending] == character
          return [character == '"' ? :string : :character, text[position..ending], ending + 1]
        end
        ending += text[ending] == '\\' && text[ending + 1] && text[ending + 1] != "\n" ? 2 : 1
      end
    end
    punctuator = PUNCTUATORS.find { |item| text[position, item.length] == item }
    return [:punctuator, punctuator, position + punctuator.length] if punctuator
    [:other, character, position + 1]
  end

  def splice(text)
    characters, positions = +'', []
    index, line = 0, 1
    while index < text.length
      if text[index, 2] == "\\\n"
        index += 2
        line += 1
        next
      end
      characters << text[index]
      positions << line
      line += 1 if text[index] == "\n"
      index += 1
    end
    [characters, positions]
  end

  def scan(text, positions, start = 1)
    lines, tokens = [], []
    index, spaced = 0, true
    while index < text.length
      case
      when text[index] == ' '
        spaced = true
        index += 1
      when text[index] == "\n"
        ending = positions[index]
        lines << LogicalLine.new(tokens.freeze, start, ending)
        tokens, start, spaced = [], ending + 1, true
        index += 1
      when text[index, 2] == '/*'
        closing = text.index('*/', index + 2)
        index = closing ? closing + 2 : text.length
        spaced = true
      when text[index, 2] == '//'
        index = text.index("\n", index + 2) || text.length
        spaced = true
      else
        header = tokens.map(&:spelling) == ['#', 'include']
        kind, spelling, ending = read_token(text, index, header)
        tokens << Token.make(kind, spelling, positions[index], spaced)
        index, spaced = ending, false
      end
    end
    lines << LogicalLine.new(tokens.freeze, start, positions.last) unless tokens.empty?
    lines.freeze
  end

  def source(text)
    spliced, positions = splice(text)
    scan(spliced, positions)
  end

  def definition(text, line)
    scan(text + "\n", Array.new(text.length + 1, line), line).flat_map(&:tokens)
  end

  def render(tokens)
    tokens.each_with_index.map { |token, i| (i.positive? && token.space ? ' ' : '') + token.spelling }.join
  end

  def single_token(text)
    return nil if text.empty? || text.start_with?('//', '/*')
    kind, _, ending = read_token(text)
    kind if ending == text.length
  end
end

class DirectiveError < StandardError; end
Header = Data.define(:rendering, :name, :quoted)
Block = Struct.new(:kind, :position, :parent, :chosen, :active, :else_seen, :skip_start, keyword_init: true)

class Inclusion
  attr_reader :source, :depth, :stack
  attr_accessor :display_file, :offset, :segment

  def initialize(source, depth)
    @source, @depth, @display_file, @offset = source, depth, source.path, 0
    @stack, @segment = [], []
  end

  def position(physical)
    [display_file, physical + offset]
  end

  def skipping?
    !stack.empty? && !stack[-1].active
  end
end

class Preprocessor
  CONDITIONALS = (IncludeSyntax::STARTS + IncludeSyntax::BRANCHES + ['endif']).freeze

  def initialize
    @macros, @ever_defined, @poisoned = {}, Set.new, Set.new
    @saved = Hash.new { |hash, key| hash[key] = [] }
    @manager = IncludeManager.new
    @expander = Expander.new(@macros, method(:diagnostic))
    @output, @history, @diagnostics = [], [], []
    @tree, @conditional_records, @regions = ['main.c'], [], []
    @diagnostic_counts, @condition_counts = Hash.new(0), Hash.new(0)
  end

  def diagnostic(position, kind, message)
    @diagnostics << "#{position.join(':')}: #{kind}: #{message}"
    @diagnostic_counts[kind] += 1
  end

  def event(position, content)
    @history << "#{position.join(':')}: #{content}"
  end

  def poison_check(context, tokens)
    tokens.each do |token|
      if token.kind == :identifier && @poisoned.include?(token.spelling)
        diagnostic(context.position(token.line), 'error', "attempt to use poisoned \"#{token.spelling}\"")
      end
    end
  end

  def unused_check(macro)
    if macro.main_file && macro.expanded.zero? && macro.tested.zero?
      diagnostic(macro.position, 'warning', "macro \"#{macro.name}\" is not used")
    end
  end

  def define(tokens, position, main_file)
    macro = Definitions.parse(tokens, position, main_file)
    previous = @macros[macro.name]
    if !previous
      @macros[macro.name] = macro
      @ever_defined << macro.name
      operation = 'define'
    elsif previous.identical?(macro)
      operation = 'identical'
    else
      unused_check(previous)
      diagnostic(position, 'warning', "\"#{macro.name}\" redefined (previous definition at #{previous.position.join(':')})")
      @macros[macro.name] = macro
      @ever_defined << macro.name
      operation = 'redefine'
    end
    event(position, "#{operation} #{macro.signature}")
  rescue Definitions::Error => error
    diagnostic(position, 'error', error.message)
  end

  def undefine(tokens, position)
    error = Definitions.check_name(tokens, 'undef')
    if error
      diagnostic(position, 'error', error)
      return
    end
    diagnostic(position, 'warning', 'extra tokens at end of #undef directive') if tokens.length >= 2
    name = tokens[0].spelling
    if @macros.key?(name)
      unused_check(@macros.delete(name))
      event(position, "undef #{name}")
    else
      event(position, "undef #{name} (not defined)")
    end
  end

  def process_defines
    File.binread('input/defines.txt').split("\n").each_with_index do |line, index|
      next if line.empty?
      text = line.include?('=') ? line.sub('=', ' ') : line + ' 1'
      define(Lexer.definition(text, index + 1), ['defines.txt', index + 1], false)
    end
  end

  def separator_needed?(left, right)
    return true if left == '/' && ['/', '*'].include?(right[0])
    Lexer.read_token(left + right)[2] != left.length
  end

  def output_render(tokens)
    previous = nil
    tokens.map do |token|
      space = previous && (token.space || separator_needed?(previous, token.spelling))
      previous = token.spelling
      (space ? ' ' : '') + token.spelling
    end.join
  end

  def marker(filename, line, flag = nil)
    @output << "# #{line} \"#{filename}\"" + (flag ? " #{flag}" : '')
    @previous = [filename, line - 1]
  end

  def output_line(context, physical, text)
    filename, line = context.position(physical)
    previous_file, previous_line = @previous
    if filename == previous_file && previous_line < line && line <= previous_line + 8
      @output.concat(Array.new(line - previous_line - 1, ''))
    else
      marker(filename, line)
    end
    @output << text
    @previous = [filename, line]
    context.source.output_lines += 1
  end

  def flush(context)
    segment, context.segment = context.segment, []
    return if segment.empty?
    poison_check(context, segment)
    @expander.expand(segment, context).chunk(&:line).each do |physical, tokens|
      output_line(context, physical, output_render(tokens))
    end
  end

  def macro_defined?(name)
    if @macros.key?(name)
      @macros[name].tested += 1
      true
    else
      Definitions::BUILTINS.include?(name) || name == '__has_include'
    end
  end

  def header_specification(tokens, position = 0)
    token = tokens[position]
    return [nil, position] unless token
    if [:string, :header].include?(token.kind)
      text = token.spelling
      return [Header.new(text, text[1...-1], text.start_with?('"')), position + 1]
    end
    return [nil, position] unless token.spelling == '<'
    closing = position + 1
    closing += 1 while tokens[closing] && tokens[closing].spelling != '>'
    raise DirectiveError, 'missing terminating > character' unless tokens[closing]
    text = '<' + Lexer.render(tokens[(position + 1)...closing]) + '>'
    [Header.new(text, text[1...-1], false), closing + 1]
  end

  def replace_operators(operands)
    replaced, position = [], 0
    while position < operands.length
      token = operands[position]
      index = position + 1
      if token.kind == :identifier && token.spelling == 'defined'
        parenthesized = operands[index]&.spelling == '('
        index += 1 if parenthesized
        raise DirectiveError, 'operator "defined" requires an identifier' unless operands[index]&.kind == :identifier
        name = operands[index].spelling
        index += 1
        if parenthesized
          raise DirectiveError, 'missing \')\' after "defined"' unless operands[index]&.spelling == ')'
          index += 1
        end
        value = macro_defined?(name)
      elsif token.kind == :identifier && token.spelling == '__has_include'
        raise DirectiveError, 'missing \'(\' after "__has_include"' unless operands[index]&.spelling == '('
        header, index = header_specification(operands, index + 1)
        raise DirectiveError, 'operator "__has_include" requires a header-name' if !header || header.name.empty?
        raise DirectiveError, 'missing \')\' after "__has_include" operand' unless operands[index]&.spelling == ')'
        index += 1
        value = !@manager.search(header.name, header.quoted).nil?
      else
        replaced << token
        position += 1
        next
      end
      replaced << Token.make(:number, value ? '1' : '0', token.line, token.space)
      position = index
    end
    replaced
  end

  def test(context, logical, name, operands)
    position = context.position(logical.tokens[0].line)
    poison_check(context, operands)
    unless %w[if elif].include?(name)
      if operands.empty? || operands[0].kind != :identifier
        message = operands.empty? ? "no macro name given in ##{name} directive" : 'macro names must be identifiers'
        diagnostic(position, 'error', message)
        return [nil, nil]
      end
      diagnostic(position, 'warning', "extra tokens at end of ##{name} directive") if operands.length >= 2
      value = macro_defined?(operands[0].spelling)
      value = !value if %w[ifndef elifndef].include?(name)
      return [value ? 1 : 0, nil]
    end
    expanded = nil
    replaced = replace_operators(operands)
    expanded = @expander.expand(replaced, context)
    tree = Expression.parse(expanded, name)
    value = Expression.evaluate(tree) { |message| diagnostic(position, 'warning', message) }
    [value, expanded]
  rescue DirectiveError, Expression::Error => error
    diagnostic(position, 'error', error.message)
    [nil, expanded]
  end

  def test_description(name, value, expanded)
    text = value.nil? ? 'not taken (error)' : value.zero? ? 'not taken' : 'taken'
    text += " (value #{value})" if !value.nil? && %w[if elif].include?(name)
    text += " [#{output_render(expanded)}]" unless expanded.nil?
    text
  end

  def close_region(context, block, ending)
    start = block.skip_start
    if start && ending >= start
      filename, first = context.position(start)
      last = context.position(ending)[1]
      @regions << "#{filename}:#{first}-#{last} lines=#{ending - start + 1}"
      context.source.skipped_lines += ending - start + 1
    end
    block.skip_start = nil
  end

  def conditional_record(position, depth, name, operands, description)
    directive = "##{name}" + (operands.empty? ? '' : ' ' + Lexer.render(operands))
    @conditional_records << "#{position.join(':')}: #{'  ' * depth}#{directive} => #{description}"
    categories = {'taken' => 'taken', 'not taken' => 'not_taken', 'skipped' => 'skipped',
                  'not evaluated' => 'not_evaluated', 'closes' => 'endif'}
    prefix = categories.keys.find { |item| description.start_with?(item) }
    @condition_counts[categories[prefix]] += 1
  end

  def conditional(context, logical, name, operands)
    position = context.position(logical.tokens[0].line)
    if IncludeSyntax::STARTS.include?(name)
      parent = !context.skipping?
      block = Block.new(kind: name, position: position, parent: parent, chosen: false,
                        active: false, else_seen: false, skip_start: nil)
      description = 'skipped'
      if parent
        value, expanded = test(context, logical, name, operands)
        block.chosen = block.active = !value.nil? && !value.zero?
        block.skip_start = logical.finish + 1 unless block.active
        description = test_description(name, value, expanded)
      end
      conditional_record(position, context.stack.length, name, operands, description)
      context.stack << block
      return
    end
    if context.stack.empty?
      diagnostic(position, 'error', "##{name} without #if")
      return
    end
    block, depth = context.stack[-1], context.stack.length - 1
    close_region(context, block, logical.start - 1)
    if name == 'endif'
      context.stack.pop
      diagnostic(position, 'warning', 'extra tokens at end of #endif directive') if block.parent && !operands.empty?
      description = "closes ##{block.kind} at line #{block.position[1]}"
    else
      diagnostic(position, 'error', "##{name} after #else") if block.else_seen
      if name == 'else'
        diagnostic(position, 'warning', 'extra tokens at end of #else directive') if block.parent && !operands.empty?
        block.else_seen = true
        block.active = block.parent && !block.chosen
        block.chosen = true if block.parent
        description = !block.parent ? 'skipped' : block.active ? 'taken' : 'not taken'
      elsif !block.parent
        block.active, description = false, 'skipped'
      elsif block.chosen
        block.active, description = false, 'not evaluated'
      else
        value, expanded = test(context, logical, name, operands)
        block.active = !value.nil? && !value.zero?
        block.chosen = true if block.active
        description = test_description(name, value, expanded)
      end
      block.skip_start = logical.finish + 1 if block.parent && !block.active
    end
    conditional_record(position, depth, name, operands, description)
  end

  def include_file(context, logical, operands)
    position = context.position(logical.tokens[0].line)
    sequence = operands
    header, consumed = header_specification(sequence)
    if !header && !sequence.empty?
      sequence = @expander.expand(sequence, context)
      header, consumed = header_specification(sequence)
    end
    raise DirectiveError, '#include expects "FILENAME" or <FILENAME>' unless header
    diagnostic(position, 'warning', 'extra tokens at end of #include directive') if consumed < sequence.length
    raise DirectiveError, 'empty filename in #include' if header.name.empty?
    prefix = '  ' * (context.depth + 1) + "#{logical.tokens[0].line}: "
    path = @manager.search(header.name, header.quoted)
    unless path
      @tree << prefix + header.rendering + ' [not found]'
      diagnostic(position, 'error', 'cannot find include file ' + header.rendering)
      return
    end
    previous = @manager.files[path]
    if previous && (previous.once || previous.guard && @macros.key?(previous.guard))
      reason = previous.once ? 'pragma once' : "guard #{previous.guard}"
      @tree << prefix + path + " [skipped: #{reason}]"
      previous.skipped += 1
    elsif context.depth + 1 > 8
      @tree << prefix + path + ' [too deep]'
      diagnostic(position, 'error', '#include nested too deeply')
    else
      @tree << prefix + path
      marker(path, 1, 1)
      process_file(path, context.depth + 1)
      filename, line = context.position(logical.finish + 1)
      marker(filename, line, 2)
    end
  rescue DirectiveError => error
    diagnostic(position, 'error', error.message)
  end

  def decimal_token?(token)
    token&.kind == :number && token.spelling.match?(/\A[0-9]+\z/)
  end

  def line_directive(context, logical, operands)
    position = context.position(logical.tokens[0].line)
    operands = @expander.expand(operands, context) unless decimal_token?(operands[0])
    unless [1, 2].include?(operands.length) && decimal_token?(operands[0]) && (operands.length == 1 || operands[1].kind == :string)
      diagnostic(position, 'error', 'invalid #line directive')
      return
    end
    line = operands[0].spelling.to_i
    unless (1..2_147_483_647).cover?(line)
      diagnostic(position, 'error', 'line number out of range')
      return
    end
    context.offset = line - logical.finish - 1
    context.display_file = operands[1].spelling[1...-1] if operands.length == 2
  end

  def macro_pragma(position, operands, operation)
    unless operands.length == 4 && operands[1].spelling == '(' && operands[2].kind == :string && operands[3].spelling == ')'
      diagnostic(position, 'error', "invalid #pragma #{operation} directive")
      return
    end
    name = operands[2].spelling[1...-1]
    if operation == 'push_macro'
      @saved[name] << @macros[name]
      event(position, "push #{name}")
    elsif @saved[name].empty?
      diagnostic(position, 'warning', "no matching push_macro for \"#{name}\"")
    else
      macro = @saved[name].pop
      if macro
        @macros[name] = macro
      else
        @macros.delete(name)
      end
      event(position, "pop #{name}" + (macro ? '' : ' (undefined)'))
    end
  end

  def pragma(context, logical, operands)
    position = context.position(logical.tokens[0].line)
    name = operands[0]&.kind == :identifier ? operands[0].spelling : nil
    if name == 'once'
      diagnostic(position, 'warning', 'extra tokens at end of #pragma once directive') if operands.length >= 2
      diagnostic(position, 'warning', '#pragma once in main file') if context.depth.zero?
      context.source.once = true
    elsif operands.take(2).map(&:spelling) == %w[GCC poison]
      unless operands.drop(2).all? { |token| token.kind == :identifier }
        diagnostic(position, 'error', 'invalid #pragma GCC poison directive')
        return
      end
      operands.drop(2).each do |token|
        diagnostic(position, 'warning', "poisoning existing macro \"#{token.spelling}\"") if @macros.key?(token.spelling)
        @poisoned << token.spelling
      end
    elsif %w[push_macro pop_macro].include?(name)
      macro_pragma(position, operands, name)
    else
      output_line(context, logical.tokens[0].line, '#pragma' + (operands.empty? ? '' : ' ' + Lexer.render(operands)))
    end
  end

  def directive(context, logical, name, operands)
    return if logical.tokens.length == 1
    poisoning = name == 'pragma' && operands.take(2).map(&:spelling) == %w[GCC poison]
    poison_check(context, operands) unless poisoning
    position = context.position(logical.tokens[0].line)
    case name
    when 'define' then define(operands, position, context.depth.zero?)
    when 'undef' then undefine(operands, position)
    when 'include' then include_file(context, logical, operands)
    when 'line' then line_directive(context, logical, operands)
    when 'error', 'warning'
      diagnostic(position, name, "##{name}" + (operands.empty? ? '' : ' ' + Lexer.render(operands)))
    when 'pragma' then pragma(context, logical, operands)
    else diagnostic(position, 'error', 'invalid preprocessing directive #' + logical.tokens[1].spelling)
    end
  end

  def process_file(path, depth)
    source = @manager.load(path)
    source.entered += 1
    context = Inclusion.new(source, depth)
    source.lines.each do |logical|
      tokens = logical.tokens
      name, operands = IncludeSyntax.directive_name(tokens), tokens.drop(2)
      if tokens[0]&.spelling == '#' && CONDITIONALS.include?(name)
        flush(context)
        conditional(context, logical, name, operands)
      elsif context.skipping?
        next
      elsif tokens[0]&.spelling == '#'
        flush(context)
        directive(context, logical, name, operands)
      else
        context.segment.concat(tokens)
      end
    end
    flush(context)
    context.stack.each { |block| close_region(context, block, source.physical_lines) }
    context.stack.each { |block| diagnostic(block.position, 'error', "unterminated ##{block.kind}") }
  end

  def include_report
    lines = @tree + ['', '== files ==']
    @manager.files.keys.sort.each do |path|
      source = @manager.files[path]
      lines << "#{path} entered=#{source.entered} skipped=#{source.skipped} lines=#{source.physical_lines} " \
               "output_lines=#{source.output_lines} skipped_lines=#{source.skipped_lines} guard=#{source.guard || '-'} once=#{source.once ? 'yes' : 'no'}"
    end
    lines << ''
    current, has_path = +'main.o:', false
    @manager.files.each_key do |path|
      if current.length + 1 + path.length > 76 && has_path
        lines << current + ' \\'
        current, has_path = +' ', false
      end
      current << ' ' << path
      has_path = true
    end
    lines << current
  end

  def references
    @macros.to_h do |name, macro|
      refs = macro.replacement.filter_map do |token|
        token.spelling if token.kind == :identifier && @macros.key?(token.spelling) && !(macro.parameters || []).include?(token.spelling)
      end
      [name, refs.uniq.sort]
    end
  end

  def recursive?(name, refs)
    pending, seen = refs[name].dup, Set.new
    until pending.empty?
      current = pending.pop
      return true if current == name
      pending.concat(refs[current]) if seen.add?(current)
    end
    false
  end

  def following(heading, items)
    heading + items.map { |item| ' ' + item }.join
  end

  def macro_report
    lines = ['== history ==', *@history, '', '== table ==']
    refs = references
    @macros.keys.sort.each do |name|
      macro = @macros[name]
      lines << "#define #{macro.signature}" + (macro.replacement.empty? ? '' : ' ' + Lexer.render(macro.replacement))
      lines << "  at #{macro.position.join(':')} expanded=#{macro.expanded} tested=#{macro.tested} recursive=#{recursive?(name, refs) ? 'yes' : 'no'}"
      lines << following('  refs:', refs[name])
    end
    objects = @macros.values.count { |macro| macro.parameters.nil? }
    lines.concat(['', "macros=#{@macros.length} object_like=#{objects} function_like=#{@macros.length - objects}"])
    lines << following('undefined:', (@ever_defined - @macros.keys.to_set).to_a.sort)
    counts = @expander.builtin_counts
    lines << "builtins: __COUNTER__=#{counts['__COUNTER__']} __FILE__=#{counts['__FILE__']} __LINE__=#{counts['__LINE__']}"
  end

  def conditional_report
    counts = @condition_counts
    @conditional_records + ['', '== skipped regions ==', *@regions, '',
      "directives=#{@conditional_records.length} taken=#{counts['taken']} not_taken=#{counts['not_taken']} " \
      "skipped=#{counts['skipped']} not_evaluated=#{counts['not_evaluated']} endif=#{counts['endif']} regions=#{@regions.length}"]
  end

  def write_reports
    reports = {'preprocessed.txt' => @output, 'includes.txt' => include_report, 'macros.txt' => macro_report,
               'conditionals.txt' => conditional_report,
               'diagnostics.txt' => @diagnostics + ["errors=#{@diagnostic_counts['error']} warnings=#{@diagnostic_counts['warning']}"]}
    Dir.mkdir('output') unless Dir.exist?('output')
    reports.each do |name, lines|
      File.binwrite(File.join('output', name), lines.map { |line| line.sub(/ +\z/, '') }.join("\n") + "\n")
    end
  end

  def run
    process_defines
    marker('main.c', 1)
    process_file('main.c', 0)
    @macros.keys.sort.each { |name| unused_check(@macros[name]) }
    write_reports
  end
end

Preprocessor.new.run if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
